label: Ophtalmologie
description: Photobiomodulation en ophtalmologie : dégénérescence maculaire liée à l'âge, myopie de l'enfant (lumière rouge basse intensité), sécheresse oculaire et dysfonction meibomienne, rétinopathie diabétique, glaucome, amblyopie.
exclusions_note: lasers de photocoagulation ou chirurgicaux, photothérapie dynamique, lumière pulsée intense seule, études hors œil…
pubmed_query: ("photobiomodulation"[tiab] OR "low-level laser"[tiab] OR "low level laser"[tiab] OR "low-intensity laser"[tiab] OR "low-power laser"[tiab] OR "LLLT"[tiab] OR "PBMT"[tiab] OR "Low-Level Light Therapy"[MeSH] OR "light-emitting diode"[tiab] OR "laser acupuncture"[tiab] OR "repeated low-level red-light"[tiab] OR "low-level red light"[tiab] OR "red light therapy"[tiab] OR "high-intensity laser"[tiab] OR "laser biostimulation"[tiab]) AND ("macular degeneration"[tiab] OR "myopia"[tiab] OR "dry eye"[tiab] OR "glaucoma"[tiab] OR "retinopathy"[tiab] OR "amblyopia"[tiab] OR "retina*"[tiab] OR "meibomian"[tiab] OR "blephar*"[tiab] OR "ocular"[tiab] OR "Eye Diseases"[MeSH]) NOT ("photodynamic"[ti])
trials_cond: "macular degeneration" OR myopia OR "dry eye" OR "meibomian gland dysfunction" OR glaucoma OR "diabetic retinopathy" OR "diabetic macular edema" OR amblyopia OR retinitis
